data.content:
damages	DNA
UV Radiation
UV radiation damages DNA, leading to mutations that can initiate basal cell skin cancer.

caused by	Basal Cell Skin Cancer
Basal Cells
Basal cells become abnormal, leading to the development of basal cell skin cancer.

exposure	Basal Cells
UV Radiation
Exposure to UV radiation from the sun or tanning beds increases the risk of abnormal basal cell proliferation.

treated by	Basal Cell Skin Cancer
Surgery
Surgery removes the cancerous tissue in basal cell skin cancer.

regulated by	Basal Cells
DNA
DNA controls basal cell growth and division.

rarely	Basal Cell Skin Cancer
Metastasis
Basal cell skin cancer rarely metastasizes to distant tissues.

risk factor	Basal Cell Skin Cancer
Sun
Sunlight exposure is a major risk factor for developing basal cell skin cancer.

risk factor	Basal Cell Skin Cancer
Tanning Beds
Tanning beds emit UV radiation, which is a risk factor for basal cell skin cancer.

case location	Basal Cell Skin Cancer
United States
Approximately 3 million cases of basal cell skin cancer are diagnosed in the United States each year.

information source	Basal Cell Skin Cancer
NCCN Guidelines for Patients
NCCN Guidelines provide recommendations for diagnosis and treatment of skin cancer.

alias	Basal Cell Carcinoma (BCC)
Basal Cell Skin Cancer
Basal cell carcinoma (BCC) is another name for basal cell skin cancer.
